profit_factor uses 99.0 sentinel when losses==0 and wins>0 — sensible but consider surfacing an explicit '∞' badge in UI to avoid misreading a huge 99.0.
Broker filter drops empty shells correctly (accounts>0 OR trades>0 OR failed>0).
